request: Create a brief patient-education scene that explains when and why a defibrillator needs to be replaced.

candidates.text: An ICD is put under the skin on your chest and wires (\'leads\') go into your heart. You will probably stay one night in the hospital. In about 5-10 years, when the battery runs out, and the ICD will need to be replaced.

candidates.text: Subcutaneous defibrillator should be considered as an alternative to transvenous defibrillator in patients with an indication for an ICD when pacing therapy for bradycardia, cardiac resynchronization, or ATP is not needed.
entities: patients with an indication for an ICD

candidates.text: Implantation of a cardioverter defibrillator is only recommended in patients who have an expectation of good quality survival >1 year.
In patients with HF and an implantable cardioverter defibrillator (ICD), amiodarone may be considered to reduce the frequency of repetitive discharges. (Strength of Evidence = C)
entities: patients with HF and an implantable cardioverter defibrillator (ICD)

candidates.text: Discuss deactivation of an implantable-cardioverter defibrillator when present
In elderly patients in whom a benefit from the defibrillator is not expected due to the patient\'s age and comorbidities, omission of ICD implantation for primary prevention may be considered.
entities: benefit from the defibrillator is not expected

candidates.text: When an ICD is indicated, it is recommended to evaluate whether the patient could benefit from CRT-defibrillator.

An ICD is not indicated for NYHA class IV patients with medication-refractory HF who are not also candidates for cardiac transplantation, an LVAD, or a CRT defibrillator that incorporates both pacing and defibrillation capabilities.

ICU staff should develop protocols for withdrawal of life-sustaining treatments and devices (implantable cardioverter-defibrillator, ventilator, ventricular assist device, inotropic or vasopressor infusions, continuous renal replacement therapies, enteral or parenteral tube feedings, and intravenous fluids)
headers: Preparedness for withdrawal of life-sustaining measures 312

candidates.text: Fluid restriction is temporary indicated in patients with severe HF and it needs to be balanced with diuretics and weather conditions. Renal function needs to be supervised. Modulate intake during periods of high heat and humidity, nausea/vomiting
